data.name: Areez
data.gender_notes: Areez is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Areez is a name that signifies nobility and exaltedness. It is derived from the Arabic word 'ariz', which means 'noble' or 'exalted'. The name Areez carries the meaning “Noble, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Areez usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Areez is associated with the concept of nobility and elevation, as mentioned in the Quran.
data.etymology: Areez belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Areez total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
